vendor: Rasa Technologies Inc. (Rasa Technologies GmbH in the EU)
product_family: Enterprise developer platform for building AI agents: the flagship self-hosted/private-cloud Rasa Platform (with Rasa Studio for design/observability), the legacy open-source Rasa Open Source framework, and Rasa-hosted trial/sandbox environments used for evaluation.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type I/II)
certifications.proof_quote: rasa.com/industries/finance-and-banking (marketing FAQ) states: 'Is Rasa compliant for financial services use cases? Yes. Rasa supports SOC 2 Type II compliance, on-premise and private cloud deployment, data residency controls, and full audit logging for every automated interaction.' However, the vendor's own dedicated security page (rasa.com/security-at-rasa) makes no SOC 2 claim anywhere and no SOC 2 attestation report, audit date, or auditor is referenced on any vendor-domain page. 'Supports SOC 2 compliance' describes product features (deployment control, audit logs) that help a customer achieve their own compliance, not a confirmed SOC 2 Type II certification of Rasa itself.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: 'Although our controls are aligned with the requirements of ISO 27002, we have broken down the sections below to align with the ISO 27001 domains to allow for customers and prospects to easily cross reference with their requirements.' This is a self-attestation of control alignment, not a certified ISMS audited against ISO 27001; no certificate number, registrar, or audit date is published.

certifications.name: ISO 27002 (control alignment, not a certification)
certifications.proof_quote: 'We have worked to ensure our security controls are aligned with ISO 27002 and we apply industry best practises wherever applicable.' This is a stated best-practice alignment, not an issued ISO certificate.

certifications.name: GDPR (posture / DPA)
certifications.proof_quote: 'The DPA only applies to Personal Data which are subject to the GDPR' (rasa.com/dpa); Rasa's Website Privacy Policy states EU-hosted Services and names a Data Protection Officer/Privacy Officer overseeing the data-protection program, with defined data-subject rights and a 30-day response commitment.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of a HIPAA compliance program, BAA offering, or HIPAA-eligible hosting tier on any vendor-domain page found.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS certification on any vendor-domain page found.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management system)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 42001 certification found on the vendor's own pages.

certifications.name: CSA STAR / CSA STAR for AI
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of a CSA STAR registration or CSA STAR AI attestation found on the vendor's own pages.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP authorization found on the vendor's own pages.

privacy.ai_training_note: Posture differs by product tier. For the self-hosted Rasa Platform / Rasa Open Source product, the Product Privacy Policy states Rasa 'do[es] not process personal data as part of the Products' beyond customer instruction (e.g. support/deployment assistance) - customers host their own instance and control their own data. For Rasa-hosted Online Services and Hosted Trial Environments, the Website Privacy Policy states conversation logs, prompts, transcripts and configurations 'may be deidentified and used for research and development, including training and improving our algorithms.' No explicit self-serve opt-out mechanism for this deidentified R&D use is documented on the vendor's pages; prospects evaluating via a Rasa-hosted trial should confirm current opt-out options directly with Rasa.
privacy.data_region: Hosted Services: European Union. Online Services (website/account infra): United States and European Union. Self-hosted Rasa Platform / Rasa Open Source deployments: fully customer-controlled (on-prem or customer's own cloud/private cloud).

security.name: Encryption
security.value: Vendor states use of NIST-recommended ciphers only (AES, RSA, SHA), with minimum key lengths of 128-bit AES, 2048-bit RSA, 256-bit SHA; weak/legacy cryptographic algorithms are disabled per CIS/OWASP guidance.

security.name: Personnel security
security.value: Employee background/screening checks performed for roles that meet defined criteria.

security.name: Vulnerability disclosure
security.value: Published Responsible Disclosure Policy for reporting security issues.

security.name: Product hosting model
security.value: Rasa Platform / Rasa Open Source is deployed by the customer (on-prem, private cloud, or customer's own cloud); Rasa states it does not host customer instances or customer data as part of the core product. Rasa's own corporate/SaaS surfaces (marketing site, docs, hosted trial) are cloud-only and hosted in the EU and/or US.

security.name: Independent audit reports
security.value: Vendor states 'Security audits are conducted to identify and address any vulnerabilities by our external Data Protection agencies' but publishes no downloadable third-party audit report, penetration-test summary, or attestation letter on any vendor-domain page found.

products.name: Rasa Platform
products.category: Enterprise AI agent builder (chat, voice/IVR, multi-agent orchestration)
products.data_scope: Self-hosted by the customer (on-prem or private/customer cloud); per the Product Privacy Policy, Rasa does not process personal data as part of the product outside of customer-instructed support/deployment assistance.
products.notes: Flagship product; homepage highlights patented dialogue management, on-prem/private-cloud deployment, multi-agent orchestration, and real-time observability. Includes Rasa Studio for design and monitoring.

products.name: Rasa Open Source
products.data_scope: Fully self-hosted by the adopter; no Rasa-side data processing.
products.notes: Legacy docs remain live at legacy-docs-oss.rasa.com; company focus has shifted to the commercial Rasa Platform.

products.name: Hosted Trial / Online Services
products.category: Rasa-operated evaluation/sandbox environment and account/marketing infrastructure
products.data_scope: Rasa-hosted; conversation logs, prompts, transcripts and configurations may be collected and deidentified data may be used for R&D and model improvement.
products.notes: Distinct privacy posture from the self-hosted Rasa Platform - this is the tier where Rasa itself processes and may train on data.

compare.pricing_model: Enterprise/custom, demo-gated (no public self-serve pricing observed; site funnels to 'Get a demo')
compare.data_residency: EU (Hosted Services); US + EU (Online Services/account infra); fully customer-controlled for self-hosted Rasa Platform/Open Source deployments

flags: Marketing FAQ (rasa.com/industries/finance-and-banking) claims 'Rasa supports SOC 2 Type II compliance' while the vendor's dedicated security page (rasa.com/security-at-rasa) makes no SOC 2 claim and no attestation report is referenced anywhere on the site.
No formal ISO 27001 certificate found; vendor only claims control alignment with ISO 27002, which is a lower bar than a certified, audited ISMS.

AI training practices differ by deployment: with the self-hosted Rasa Platform product, Rasa does not process customer data, but Rasa-hosted trial and online services may use deidentified conversation data for model training with no documented opt-out. Enterprise buyers evaluating via a hosted trial should keep this in mind.

Not to be confused with 'rasa.io' (an unrelated newsletter/marketing company) or 'rasa.li' (an unrelated food-sourcing app); this report covers Rasa Technologies Inc. / Rasa Technologies GmbH (rasa.com).
